summary.text: Jason Elliott is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 6 in Greenville County.
He is an attorney who previously served in the S.C. House of Representatives from 2017 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Elliott was born on July 1, 1970, in Greenville.
His official page lists a B.A. from Clemson University in 1993 and a J.D. from the University of South Carolina in 1996.
He was an assistant solicitor for the Tenth Judicial Circuit from 1996 to 1999 and district director for U.S. Representative Jim DeMint from 1999 to 2003.
He served on the Greenville Tech Charter High School board from 2002 to 2006, chairing it in 2005 and 2006, and on the Greenville County Legislative Transportation Committee from 2011 to 2016.
He served in the S.C. House from 2017 to 2024.
His Senate committees are Agriculture and Natural Resources, Education, Family and Veterans' Services, Judiciary and Rules.
